title: bidens pilosa var. radiata
intro: Bidens pilosa var. radiata, commonly known as creeping beggar ticks, is a variety of the Bidens pilosa plant, a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions. The Bidens pilosa var. radiata plant has been reported to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of relieving pain, reducing fever, and treating wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
